profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer on Vault Radar
profile.summary:
I am an experienced software engineer with an unwavering passion for his craft. I have a strong background in storage, virtualization, and cloud-native applications, with a proven ability to design and deliver scalable, high-performance software architectures that drive operational efficiency and innovation. I have extensive experience in driving strategic initiatives and leading the delivery of highly visible projects - on time. My expertise in software development and automation have enabled teams to reduce deployment times, lower infrastructure costs, and enhance system reliability - driving business growth and competitive advantage.

In my off time, I enjoy streamlining existing and experimenting with new services in my homelab. Including: 
- Spinning up new resources with Terraform on my Proxmox cluster
- AI stack w/Open WebUI, llama-swap, llama.cpp, and Ollama using multi modal conversation pipelines leveraging multiple GPU's/LLM's.
- Constantly tweaking configuration management for all hosts
- CI pipelines with Gitlab
- Full device monitoring/alerting using Zabbix/Grafana

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer on Vault Radar
Senior DevSecOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Led end-to-end design and implementation of a fully automated secrets provisioning solution using HashiCorp Vault, enabling cloud service teams to self-manage microservice secrets globally.
- Eliminated 100% of manual updates and improved security compliance across 50+ cloud service teams in IBM Cloud's distributed environment, reducing provisioning time from hours to minutes.
- Engineered robust monitoring and alerting systems for SRE teams, reducing incident response times through automated health checks.
- Developed scalable tooling using Go, Bash, and Ansible, enhancing operational efficiency and system reliability across IBM Cloud's global infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and executed end-to-end cloud migration of enterprise build infrastructure (IaaS), enabling scalable, secure, and automated software delivery for 100+ microservices
- Implemented container image signature verification across all cloud deployments, enforcing zero-trust security policies through compliant microservice releases
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement CI/CD pipelines from development to production, accelerating feature delivery cycles while ensuring consistent pipeline reliability
- Leveraged Terraform, Ansible, Python, Bash, Kubernetes, and HashiCorp Vault to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, secrets management, and environment standardization - enabling zero-touch provisioning.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and developed a scalable build metadata service using Python, RESTful APIs, Nginx, and MySQL to track and annotate build artifacts (BOM, dependencies, tooling). The solution enhanced build reproducibility and enabled audit trails for regulatory compliance, directly supporting faster time-to-market for critical applications. Developed diagnostics for EMC's VPlex virtual storage solution that minimized field tech traffic and enabled support teams to accelerate root-cause analysis and resolve critical storage incidents. Led build tools effort on new product from legacy build artifact management to Artifactory; implemented package signing for all customer deliverables.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected a modular automation framework for Certeon’s WAN acceleration virtual appliance, enabling rapid prototyping and streamlined testing across hypervisor environments (ESXi, Hyper-V, Xen). Provided technical leadership amongst peers in test automation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented core features on IBRIX Fusion Manager (system management platform) – including configuration, monitoring, file/data replication/management (intra/inter cluster), user management, and failover for the IBRIX Fusion File System (distributed file system). Collaborated with QA and Technical writing staff for designing unit tests on new features and customer facing documentation, accelerating feature delivery and improving product quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Host based and Embedded)
positions.description: Responsibilities include developing new/enhancing EMC’s diagnostic applications (Windows/UNIX/Embedded environments) (i.e. ArrayX) designed for testing existing and next generation Fibre Channel/SCSI/SATA/PATA/iSCSI/SAS drives in our NAS/SAN storage systems (Clariion), building drive firmware. Examples of the various diagnostics were FBI monitoring, testing of various drive commands (write/read buffer, write same, mode sense/select, identify/inquiry, capacity), i/o exerciser (arrayX). I also created a web/gui frontend for remote monitoring of the i/o exerciser.
